claim.claim-text: 1. A joining system suitable for being used in furniture and furnishing items (M) with a bottom (12) and at least one shoulder (11) positionable with respect to a floor (P), the joining system comprising, in combination, at least one front foot unit (114) and at least one rear foot unit (115), wherein each front and rear foot unit (114,115) comprises at least one connection group (GC) and a blocking group (GB) of a joining device for stably interconnecting said bottom (12) and said at least one shoulder, wherein said connection group (GC) and said blocking group (GB) of the joining device can be actuated, when mounted, from the front of the furniture,

said at least one front foot unit (114) and said at least one rear foot unit (115) are suitable for being positioned beneath said bottom (12) and facing said at least one shoulder (11), wherein said bottom (12) and said at least one shoulder (11) do not rest on the floor, said at least one front foot unit (114) and said at least one rear foot unit (115) are positioned in an identical body (116) for both said at least one front foot unit (114) and said at least one rear foot unit (115), and actuation rods (36) of the joining device are provided, arranged in said at least one rear foot unit (115), positioned between said at least one front foot unit (114) and said at least one rear foot unit (115) .

2. The system according to claim 1, characterized in that said actuation rod (36) of said blocking group (GB) of said rear foot units (115) is positioned, when mounted, tilted on a plane perpendicular to the floor between said at least one front foot unit (114) and said at least one rear foot unit (115) .

3. The system according to any of the previous claims, characterized in that each body (16) of said front and rear foot units (114 ; 115) comprises a moulded body in zamak or in another suitable material, which provides voids and lightening and/or stiffening ribs.

4. The system according to claim 1, characterized in that said body (116) can be associated beneath the bottom (12) and facing said at least one shoulder (11) and provides, from at least one short side, a protruding appendix or nose (117) which is suitable for being inserted in a complementary slot-shaped recess (18) formed in the shoulder (11).

5. The system according to claim 4, characterized in that said protruding appendix or nose (117) also has an undercut (119) that is abutted against the short side of the bottom (12) facing the shoulder (11).

6. The system according to any of the previous claims, characterized in that said body (116), in a surface facing said bottom (12), provides a pair of pegs (120) protruding above, which are inserted in blind holes (22) formed on a lower surface (23) facing downwards towards the same bottom (12) .

7. The system according to any of the previous claims, characterized in that said blocking group (GB) of the joining device of each front foot unit (114) and rear foot unit (115) comprises a pin (38), for positioning integrally in a shoulder (11), and said blocking group (GB) of the joining device comprises a grub screw (134) which can be moved from an engagement position to a disengagement position with said pin (38) .

8. The system according to claim 7, characterized in that said body (116), on one of its short sides facing the shoulder (11), provides a blind hole (137) which receives said pin (38) forming part of the connection group (GC) .
9. The system according to claim 7 or 8, characterized in that said pin (38) has the same length for said front foot unit (114) and said rear foot unit (115).
